lines.say: Your whole shop just went down because the reviews got slow. Not broken. Just slow.
lines.show: Your whole shop just [went down] because the *reviews* got slow. Not broken. Just *slow.*

lines.say: Your shop's server waits for reviews from another server. Waiting work piles up until the whole shop stops loading.
lines.show: Your shop's server *waits* for reviews from another server. Waiting work piles up until the whole shop [stops loading.]

lines.say: A circuit breaker protects your house by cutting the power when something goes wrong. In software, it stops requests to the struggling server.
lines.show: A [circuit breaker] protects your house by cutting the *power* when something goes wrong. In software, it stops requests to the *struggling server.*

lines.say: Too many slow or failed requests? It pauses new requests for a while.
lines.show: Too many *slow or failed* requests? It [pauses new requests] for a while.

lines.say: Your code decides what happens instead: skip the reviews and load the rest of the page.
lines.show: Your code decides what happens instead: [skip the reviews] and load the *rest of the page.*

lines.say: Later, it lets a few requests through. Reviews fast again? Resume. Otherwise, pause again.
lines.show: Later, it lets a *few requests* through. Reviews fast again? [Resume.] Otherwise, *pause* again.

lines.say: That keeps one slow feature from sinking your whole app.
lines.show: That keeps one slow feature from [sinking your whole app.]

lines.say: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI skipped.
lines.show: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI [skipped.]
